# One runtime call per line, played by tests/test_love_runtime.c through the
# C runtime and by main.lua through game/p8/ and game/love/. `frame` ends a
# frame; integers are decimal or 0x hex.
cls
frame
# pset: corners, every colour, off-screen on each side, under a camera.
pset 0 0 7
pset 159 0 8
pset 0 119 9
pset 159 119 10
pset 10 10 0
pset 11 10 1
pset 12 10 2
pset 13 10 3
pset 14 10 4
pset 15 10 5
pset 16 10 6
pset 17 10 11
pset 18 10 12
pset 19 10 13
pset 20 10 14
pset 21 10 15
pset -1 5 7
pset 160 5 7
pset 5 -1 7
pset 5 120 7
pset -2000000 5 7
camera -20 30
pset 0 0 12
pset 140 -30 13
pset -21 50 7
pset 0 90 7
frame
# psets: runs of one colour, colour changes, off-screen points inside a run,
# the camera of the previous frame carried over.
psets 30 40 8 31 40 8 32 40 8 33 40 9 34 40 9 35 40 8
psets 40 50 3 -100 50 3 41 50 3 300 50 3 42 50 3
psets 1 1 7
camera 0 0
psets 0 0 14 159 119 15 158 119 15
frame
# rectfill without a pattern: corners in either order, one pixel, a line,
# partly and wholly off screen, the whole screen and beyond, a colour byte
# with a high nibble (masked to the low one), under a camera.
rectfill -5 -5 200 200 1
rectfill 10 10 20 15 8
rectfill 40 30 30 20 9
rectfill 50 50 50 50 7
rectfill 60 5 90 5 11
rectfill 150 110 170 130 12
rectfill -10 60 3 70 13
rectfill 200 10 220 20 14
rectfill 10 -30 20 -1 14
rectfill 100 60 120 80 0x5a
camera 15 -10
rectfill 0 0 10 10 2
rectfill 160 100 180 140 3
rectfill -5000 50 5000 52 4
camera 0 0
frame
# line: one pixel, horizontal, vertical, both diagonals, steep and shallow
# slopes in each direction, ends off screen on every side, wholly off screen,
# under a camera.
line 5 5 5 5 7
line 10 2 40 2 8
line 2 10 2 40 9
line 10 10 30 30 10
line 30 40 10 60 11
line 50 5 57 40 12
line 70 40 63 5 13
line 60 50 100 57 14
line 100 65 60 58 15
line -20 80 40 90 6
line 140 70 200 100 5
line 120 -10 125 20 4
line 80 100 90 140 3
line -30 -30 -10 -5 7
line 170 10 190 50 7
camera -10 20
line 0 0 20 10 8
line 140 -20 160 0 9
camera 0 0
frame
# lines: one colour over several segments in list order (a later segment
# crossing an earlier one), a degenerate segment, segments partly and wholly
# off screen, a single segment, under a camera.
lines 12 10 10 60 50 10 50 60 10 35 35 35 35 -20 5 30 5 170 90 200 110
lines 7 80 80 80 80
camera 30 -15
lines 2 100 0 140 40 140 40 100 0
camera 0 0
frame
# rect: corners in either order, one pixel, one row, one column, edges partly
# and wholly off screen, enclosing the whole screen, under a camera.
rect 10 10 30 20 8
rect 60 40 40 25 9
rect 5 50 5 50 7
rect 10 60 40 60 10
rect 50 60 50 90 11
rect -10 70 20 100 12
rect 140 -5 170 30 13
rect 100 100 200 200 14
rect 200 10 220 20 7
rect -1 -1 160 120 15
rect -2 -2 161 121 15
camera -40 25
rect 0 0 30 20 6
rect 90 -30 130 10 5
camera 0 0
frame
# circ: radius 0, small and large radii, a negative radius (nothing), partly
# off screen on each side, enclosing the screen, wholly off screen, under a
# camera.
circ 10 10 0 7
circ 20 20 1 8
circ 40 20 2 9
circ 70 30 7 10
circ 80 60 30 11
circ 0 60 12 12
circ 159 60 12 13
circ 80 0 9 14
circ 80 119 9 15
circ 80 60 100 6
circ 50 50 -1 7
circ -40 -40 10 7
camera 20 -20
circ 40 40 15 5
camera 0 0
frame
# circfill without a pattern: radius 0, small and large radii, a negative
# radius (nothing), partly off screen on each side, enclosing the screen,
# wholly off screen, a colour byte with a high nibble (masked to the low
# one), under a camera.
circfill 80 60 100 1
circfill 10 10 0 7
circfill 20 20 1 8
circfill 40 20 2 9
circfill 70 30 7 10
circfill 80 70 25 11
circfill 0 60 12 12
circfill 159 60 12 13
circfill 80 0 9 14
circfill 80 119 9 15
circfill 50 50 -1 7
circfill -40 -40 10 7
circfill 120 90 6 0xc3
camera 20 -20
circfill 40 40 15 5
camera 0 0
frame
# rectfill with a pattern: the high nibble on set bits, the low one on clear
# bits, the pattern aligned on the world coordinates under several camera
# phases (negative ones included), corners in either order, clipped on every
# side, one pixel; transparent bits leaving what is under them; the pattern
# kept across calls until fillp_reset, then a plain fill again.
rectfill -5 -5 200 200 1
fillp 0x5a5a
rectfill 2 3 41 22 0x8c
rectfill 50 30 44 4 0x8c
rectfill -7 -6 5 8 0x8c
rectfill 150 110 175 130 0x8c
rectfill 60 60 60 60 0x8c
camera -1 2
rectfill 70 10 101 29 0x8c
camera 3 -5
rectfill 110 10 141 29 0x8c
camera -6 -7
rectfill 0 40 33 59 0x8c
camera 1001 -2003
rectfill 1045 -1963 1078 -1944 0x8c
camera 0 0
fillp 0x8421
rectfill 120 70 155 100 0x3b
fillp_transparent 0x0f0f
rectfill 2 70 50 105 0x2e
camera 2 1
rectfill 55 70 100 105 0x2e
camera 0 0
fillp_reset
rectfill 104 104 112 112 0x67
frame
# circfill with a pattern: span by span on the world phase, radius 0 and
# small radii, partly off screen, under several camera phases, transparent
# bits over an earlier fill, the patterns of the previous frame reused.
rectfill -5 -5 200 200 1
fillp 0x5a5a
circfill 20 20 15 0x8c
circfill 50 10 0 0x8c
circfill 60 10 1 0x8c
circfill 75 12 3 0x8c
circfill 0 60 14 0x8c
circfill 159 100 18 0x8c
camera -3 1
circfill 100 30 17 0x8c
camera 5 -6
circfill 140 30 12 0x8c
camera 0 0
fillp 0x8421
circfill 40 90 22 0x3b
fillp_transparent 0x0f0f
circfill 40 90 16 0x2e
camera -7 -2
circfill 90 80 20 0x2e
camera 0 0
fillp_reset
circfill 120 70 4 0x67
frame
